rationale: The agent located the user by name and ZIP and accessed multiple order details, then performed an exchange on order #W3470184. However, it executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the change with the user, including the specific item IDs and the payment method (gift card) to be used. The agent also did not demonstrate that the chosen replacement item met the user’s criteria (same water resistance and cheapest among the rest of the order) and did not provide final, specific information about the exchange (charges/credits, return instructions). These issues violate the policy requirements to confirm every order-changing action before taking it and to provide correct, supported final information. Therefore, the outcome fails the pass bar.
